ranked_root_causes.cause: functional barrier is weak or too late at the clipping-free reference
ranked_root_causes.interpretation: The geometric skin metric is not enough unless A/D/M also suppress the source or transport before a steady balance forms.

ranked_root_causes.cause: late-time dynamics collapse to a steady source/loss and supply/consumption balance
ranked_root_causes.interpretation: A relaxation loop needs delayed negative feedback and reset; the selected reference instead approaches a non-oscillatory balance.

ranked_root_causes.cause: legacy J-dependent source scaling is not by itself a clean oscillation mechanism in this local test set
ranked_root_causes.interpretation: If beta changes do not create clipping-free cycles, J R is at most a sensitivity or artifact candidate, not decisive positive evidence.

ranked_root_causes.cause: accessibility, solute transport, and solvent mobility suppressions do not individually reveal a hidden clean oscillator near the reference
ranked_root_causes.interpretation: The missing loop is not recovered by simply removing one suppression channel around the selected reference.

ranked_root_causes.cause: high-amplitude or near-loop behavior is contaminated by clipping/projection
ranked_root_causes.interpretation: The high-supply and high-forcing cases are useful clues that a delayed loop may be nearby, but they are numerical artifacts until a zero-clipping case shows sustained complete cycles.
